resolved_conflicts.explanation: The museum ('built C. 1930') and the Montana marker (manufactured 1930) agree on about 1930. firelookout.com says the L-4 tower was built in 1935. The story leads with the 1930 figure and reports the 1935 claim.
The museum and marker say 1983 and that the whole lookout was dismantled and moved. firelookout.com says 1984 and only the cab and top two-thirds. The story uses 1983 and flags the other account.

notes_for_editor: No correction to the record: the OSM-based 1930 build year on the record is supported by the museum and marker. The Waymarking search snippet gives 1937 for the build; that page was not read and is not used. The firelookout.com header 'R.I.P. 1928-1966' is not explained by the page and is not used. The record's original-site county (Granite) matches firelookout.com and Kemnow. The 'Phillipsburg' spelling is the source's; the story uses Philipsburg. The museum page describes a landing between two flights of stairs, which the access note reports without saying the tower is open to climbing. Budget: one WebSearch; four distinct pages read, no repeats.
